svg.text: 🎬 COMPETITION DEMO SEQUENCE — Blind-Assistance Module
14-step live demo · Boot → AI analysis → spoken guidance · Arduino Physical AI Challenge 2026

g.text: UNO Q boots from power bank → BlindAssist mode: camera, screen, LTE initialize

svg.text: ESP32 CAM starts streaming → "Camera active" · 640×480 @ 8.9fps
LTE modem connects → "Internet ready" · Quectel EG800AK on Airtel 4G
Tailscale mesh established → UNO Q ↔ Jetson ↔ VPS all ping verified
Dual Screen: neutral eye expression + "BlindAssist Ready" scrolling text
Speaker: "System ready. Blind assistance active." · Piper TTS voice
User speaks: "What's around me?" → Whisper transcribes → command matched
ESP32 CAM captures JPEG frame → sent to UNO Q over WiFi USB-C
UNO Q routes frame to Jetson over Tailscale (100.84.235.7 → 100.122.31.46)
Jetson YOLOv8n: "person 94%" · "door 87%" · "stairs 91%" · "chair 78%"
Jetson Phi-3 4K reasons: "Hallway. Door ahead 5m. Person left. Stairs down. Exit right."
Analysis returned to UNO Q → Dual Screen: ⚠️ alert + text display
Speaker: "Door ahead, 5 meters. Person on your left. Stairs going down. Exit to your right."
Demo complete — all 10 components verified · SENSE → SPEAK in ~800ms ✅
